notes.title: Hotfix - Code (Backend)
notes.notes:
Quickfix : Thank you for pointing out (User: JK).

Single deck games (more likely) would seem to provide 'odd' true counts (based on the cards being dealt). The card deal had an error when trying to pull the last index (deck of cards), due to a (silly) error on my part. 

Code is now corrected + will pull on cards as intended.

Apologies.

-Sus

notes.title: Music Player + Mini-Update (24.01.22)
notes.notes:
Existing Models: Streamlined, to ease game loading times (still working on this, but the bulk is configured/sorted!).
Updated Code to Session Stats.
Introduced a; (Basic) Music Player (Next to Trophies Vending Machine). Will cycle songs in the genres: 

- Chill Playlist 
- EDM Chill Playlist 
- Jazz Chill Playlist
(Or just random Mix)

'F' to Sit, Set to Invisible whilst using Music/Interaction.

Volume (adjustable) is independent of game sound(s).

(Feedback on if I should include more tracks etc. would be appreciated! Otherwise, I'll keep slowly adding -within reason).

- Sus.

notes.title: Update - Session Monitor | Statistics' (23.01.22)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

- Introduced a Session Monitor (Providing Stat.'s).
	> This will allow access to the current LIVE game data (details below).
	> It will also allow access to the past 25 Sessions Played.

Details Stored:

1) Rounds Won/Lost (+Ratio).
2) Starting & End of Session $ (+Ratio).

(Only after the alteration of Player's funds; data is then stored to the collection of previous games).

I'll be improving the code for this over the next few updates.

- Sus.

notes.title: Quick Patch (17.01.22)
notes.notes:
- Player is now able to Double-down with an Ace + 'Other' Card. i.e Ace + a 5 (= a 16 or a 6), 
Doubling (with the Ace) reduces the total count by 10 and issues one final card.

- Dealer is now limited/capped at a 100k (max.) Balance (Easier enabling the 
player to; eventually, beat the Dealer).

- Small visual update to the surrounds of Basic Strategy, Adv. Deviations, 
& the True Count Tend Line.

- Flip the Dealer off: 'Thumb Mouse Button' or 'G'.

- Projector Zoom Level: + or - to Zoom.
